task: Fix APISIX bootstrap CIDR rendering, align Cilium pod allocation, opt APISIX workloads out of ambient enrollment, and recover aborted ingress resources

events.summary: Issues #228 and #229 report live clean-install evidence from 2026-09-28: APISIX nginx rejected literal ${POD_NETWORK_CIDR}; real pod IPs were 10.0.x.x while kubeadm used 10.244.0.0/16; the APISIX and ingress-controller Pods lacked dataplane-mode=none and controller traffic to Admin API :9180 failed; controller 1.8.0 left ApisixUpstream and ApisixRoute resources in ResourceSyncAborted/not found.

Substitute only the APISIX CIDR token and fail on unresolved shell placeholders; remove the obsolete ConfigMap allowlist sed. Configure Cilium's cluster pool from POD_NETWORK_CIDR with /24 node masks and add a live kubeadm/CiliumNode containment verifier. Remove unsupported podLabels chart values, patch both Deployment pod templates and assert live Pod labels. Add bounded status-driven CR recreation after route apply and controller readiness.
R180-R183 and R180b-R183b pass, including mutation checks for placeholder substitution, Cilium pool binding, pod label assertion, and bounded ResourceSyncAborted recovery.
ShellCheck warning severity and bash syntax checks passed for all changed shell scripts.
Lead to rerun a clean install and verify live Cilium podCIDRs, both APISIX pod labels, controller Admin API sync, and absence of remaining ResourceSyncAborted CRs.
events.scope: Clean-install Kubernetes runtime on the target cluster

events.summary: Added one dated lessons-log row for each of the four distinct root causes and their discriminators.

Review round #228/#229: move the APISIX unresolved-placeholder guard after CIDR substitution; invoke the live pod-CIDR verifier after successful Cilium readiness; warn without mutation when an existing cluster pool differs from POD_NETWORK_CIDR.

Review regression executed the extracted APISIX heredoc, substitution, and guard against a temporary file with POD_NETWORK_CIDR=10.244.0.0/16; the swapped bad ordering failed as expected. Static checks also confirmed verifier wiring and a non-mutating warning on existing pool mismatch. shellcheck --severity=warning and bash -n passed for scripts/**/*.sh; Kakao static regression passed 217 checks with 4 existing warnings.
